breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=0.4 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 0.3].
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency according to the ground truth. The original prompt had a conflict between the time domain `t in [0, 0.3]` and the requested output time `T=0.4`. The ground truth resolved this by changing the output time to `T=0.3` to match the domain. The agent did the opposite; it changed the time domain to `t in [0, 0.4]` to match the original incorrect output request. This does not align with the ground truth's correction.
